title: Westline Email: PO WFS-77302 Wrong Ship-To

fields.to: Pinecrest Order Entry <orders@pinecrestfresh.example>; VP Supply Chain
fields.subject: PO WFS-77302 – wrong ship-to
fields.body:
Hi,

Our PO WFS-77302 for 220 cs spring mix, delivery Thursday 10/14, has the ship-to as our Modesto warehouse. That building closed at the end of August. It should go to the Sacramento Unified central kitchen, which is already on your ship-to list under our account.

Can you fix it in your ERP before it goes to the Stockton pick? I've attached the PO with the correct ship-to marked. The receiving window at the central kitchen is 05:00 to 09:00, same as before.

Also, is spring mix affected by whatever's going on? Our school kitchen manager asked me this morning, and I don't know what to tell her. She has lunch service menus to finalize today.

Thanks,
Marisol
fields.signature:
Marisol Ortega
Purchasing Clerk, Produce
Westline Foodservice | Sacramento, CA
916-555-0147

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The VP Supply Chain should hand the ship-to fix to order entry as routine work and not pull the Traceability Lead off the reconciliation. Trace should only confirm that spring mix is not one of the five Line 2 romaine lots, and the answer to the school should go through Customer Service using the approved script, without guessing about the cause.
